Engineering toolkit

AI-assisted, human-approved.

I build and maintain an AI developer platform that my team uses with Claude Code, the Claude desktop app and other coding assistants. It turns everyday engineering jobs into repeatable commands with the same rules every time.

Principles

How the platform behaves.

Approval before change

Every command that edits code or data stops for a human go-ahead first. Skipping the gate is an explicit opt-in.

Read-only by default

Integrations with databases, the issue tracker, source control, logs and metrics are read-only. Data fixes are written as scripts for review, never run.

Load only what’s needed

Coding standards, rules and domain knowledge are loaded on demand for the task at hand instead of all at once.

One source of truth

A single command registry drives every assistant integration, and CI rejects commands that are referenced but not defined.

Portable core

Company-specific knowledge sits behind one profile file, so the core can be reused by another team.

Knowledge-graph first

Agents ask a code knowledge graph for flows, usages and impact before scanning source files.

Commands

Everyday engineering jobs, made repeatable.

Works with Claude Code, the Claude desktop app (packaged as a plugin), GitHub Copilot and OpenCode, plus a standalone runner for unattended tasks with iteration, attempt and timeout limits.

Delivery

Bug fix
Root-causes a defect from a ticket, stack trace, log or screenshot and proposes a fix for approval.
New development
Designs and implements features from a story, document or screenshot.
AI developer agent
Executes a written plan or spec end to end: analyse, plan, execute, validate, fix. Single- or multi-agent.
Migration
Moves a change between branches or releases, either as the smallest exact diff or as the full capability.
UI design update
Fixes UI bugs or applies design changes while preserving Angular bindings or Flutter widget structure.

Planning & review

Planning
Turns a story or bug report into a technical plan and a test-case sheet.
Plan reviewer
Scores a plan against real evidence (code, database, logs, metrics, events, requirements) and only approves it when every score clears the bar.
Bulk issue report
Summarises a list of tickets with status and evidence-backed root causes. Read-only.

Quality

Test
Detects the test stack, reports coverage gaps for a change and scaffolds the missing tests.
Data correction
Analyses data issues and writes correction scripts for manual review. It never runs them.
Prompt audit
Scores prompts against the CRISP framework and suggests a tighter rewrite.

Knowledge

Knowledge capture
Records what was learned during a task so later agents can reuse it.
Usage report
Summarises prompt and session history with quality scoring.
